mechanism: Match the full boundary of one actual X-shaped five-cell subset in the source board with the congruent X-shaped pentomino E. Targets the local-to-global error that one legal placement establishes a three-copy partition. Every red edge participates in the same concrete cross correspondence; uncolored internal grid edges remain intact.
mathematical_solution: All options have area five, so the 15-cell board needs three congruent copies. Exhaustively enumerate all placements under all eight square-grid isometries and all unordered disjoint triples. The frozen board is a 4x4 square minus its lower-right unit cell. The original A pentomino has two complete tilings, while B,C,D,E each have zero; saved mathematical_enumeration.json records every shape, placement count, solution count and A witnesses. In particular an X-shaped patch can occur locally but three X shapes cannot cover the board. Therefore A remains the unique option. Appearance colors do not impose mandatory cut lines or change the available grid cells.
human_gate: Twenty-four original unit boundary segments receive 2pt red style, 12 enclosing a genuine source-board cross and 12 enclosing E. All interior grid edges remain black and visible, as do the full 4x4-minus-corner outline, all five option shapes and letters. No line is added/removed, so no cell count or cut target changes.
